title: Seagrove Beach "Wild Blue" 119 Dune Estates Blvd
h1: Seagrove Beach "Wild Blue" 119 Dune Estates Blvd
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf views- Private pool *Pool can be heated for an additional $30 per day between Oct 1-May 1- Shared tennis courts - Great balcony space- 5 adult bikes- 6-passenger LSV golf cart- Elevator- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDESCRIPTION: Legendary coastal fun awaits at Wild Blue! The perfect blend of comfort and indulgence, this 3-story, 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom masterpiece boasts breathtaking Gulf views and accommodates up to 14 guests in unmatched comfort. Time slows down in Seagrove Beach, where guests will find plenty of quintessential beach activities both on and off the water. Imagine a getaway filled with quiet morning swims in the private pool, vibrant sunsets enjoyed from the Gulf-facing balconies, and quick strolls to the beach—only a 3-minute walk away.The first level welcomes guests with a charming living space and adjacent wet bar. Craft a refreshing drink before stepping outside to enjoy the covered porch and private pool. This level features 2 beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with a queen bed, and 1 bunk room with 3 twin-over-twin beds.Artfully adorned with natural wood beams and shiplap walls, the second-level great room offers a curated coastal escape made for lively gatherings. In the gourmet kitchen, Thermador appliances and a vast island seating 4 set the stage for delicious home-cooked meals, shared at the handcrafted wooden table for 10. The living space’s plush furnishings invite cozy evenings catching up with loved ones or watching movies on the wall-mounted TV. When the coastal breeze calls, slide open the glass doors to find the spacious balcony, complete with a built-in grill and alfresco 8-seat dining table. A guest bedroom featuring a queen bed and a private bathroom promises a comfortable evening retreat. For convenience, there is an in-home elevator.The third level hosts the crown jewel: a sun-filled observation balcony with panoramic Gulf views. An additional living area makes it easy for guests to unwind in style. For ultimate relaxation, the private primary bedroom features a king bed and a spa-inspired private bathroom.Embrace extravagant 30A living at Seagrove Beach’s Wild Blue. There’s parking for 3 vehicles, or guests can explore the neighborhood on the 5 provided adult bikes or 6-passenger low speed vehicle. For beach access, turn left out the back gate onto Chivas Lane and take a right on Beachfront Trail. Walton Dunes Beach Access will be at the curve in the road. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Three Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only THIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub SeparateWeddings are not allowed at this home.
